label: Roman-numeral output support

skill.description: Arabic-to-Roman numeral conversion, with numeric extraction control.
skill.name: roman_numeral

weight_rationale: L30 neuron 3929 aligns .365 with Roman numeral output direction; unembedding projection promotes IV (4.83), II (4.74), III (4.67), VI VII IX VIII and their unspaced/lowercase variants. A three-unit exploratory ablation including it caused .355 Roman conversion drop with minimal collateral effects; isolate the Roman-specific neuron.

label: English number-word response support

skill.description: Map a single digit to its English cardinal or ordinal word, motivated by L28H0 value/output projections promoting four/fourth and seven/seventh. Controls copy the provided answer word.
skill.name: digit_to_word

weight_rationale: Static OV survey motivated digit lexicalization testing. Follow-up weight inspection shows H2 maps digits toward yes/False and H9 toward closing delimiters, unlike direct copying heads; label is task support, not intrinsic number encoding. Attribution independently ranked H2/H9 .069/.057, and joint ablation causes .170 digit-to-word drop with .001 matched control and <=.040 other-task drops.

label: weekday-offset support

skill.description: Compute a weekday after an integer day offset; matched controls copy an unrelated event tag in the same calendar format.
skill.name: weekday_offset

weight_rationale: Weight anchor L10 unit2898 promotes weekday/week/weekend vocabulary (cos .075-.094), and single-unit ablation drops weekday_offset .094. Eight same-layer attribution-supported units test a distributed calendar component; lexical gate/up interpretation remains uncertain.

label: Signed-product polarity support

skill.description: Determine positive or negative sign of a product of signed integers; control asks sign of explicitly identified first factor using the identical expression.
skill.name: product_sign

weight_rationale: H6 static OV maps + toward - and closing ) toward positive/true; H24 maps +/- toward digit directions and ) toward no/if. These are candidate conditional sign/factor pathways, not pure sign copying. Attribution independently favors both (.087/.079); paired ablation drops product_sign .182 with first-factor control .050 and other skill/control drops <=.043.

label: Spelled-out ordinal production

skill.description: Convert positions 1-10 to English ordinal words, compared with extracting the position number.
skill.name: ordinal_word

weight_rationale: Weight readout: 12193 promotes third/fourth/fifth and capitalization variants; 12060 promotes spell, spelled, spelling (also sor/wizard, so polysemantic). Both rank highly in ordinal attribution, making a small plausible spelling-plus-ordinal output cluster.

label: Calendar-name completion support

skill.description: Name the weekday immediately following a supplied day, with matched control retrieving a marker number.
skill.name: weekday_successor

weight_rationale: L26 2222 promotes all month names and has .2523 weekday-mean cosine; 7085 promotes Month/month/Period/Spring/Season, a broader temporal-label feature. Independent attribution ranks 7085 first and 2222 fourth for weekday successor, supporting a two-unit calendar completion cluster.

label: Language-identification answer-support cluster

skill.description: Expand common two-letter language codes into English language names; matched control copies the code.
skill.name: language_name

weight_rationale: Expand the layer34 language-support candidates after a four-unit search effect .196 failed held-out. The inspected anchor 11779 outputs Arabic/Islamic/Muslim, 7349 includes Maori/Nepali, and 1220/696 output boundary tokens. Eight independent attribution-ranked units test distributed task support; interpretation remains benchmark-specific.

label: Signed-product answer support

skill.description: Infer sign of product of two explicitly signed integers; control selects the larger magnitude using the same format.
skill.name: product_sign

weight_rationale: Weight-derived sign input anchors 856 negative (.465/.392 gate/up),7480 positive (.440/-.428),5111 plus/minus plus answer-keyword5104 (.385/.357). Added independently attribution-ranked8818 (Brown lexical readout, mechanism unclear); full 5-unit ablation gives .210 product-sign drop with -.016 matched control and <=.010 other target drops. Label is task support, not a claimed sign algorithm.

label: Language-name lexical and contextual support

skill.description: Expand common two-letter language codes into English language names; matched control copies the code.
skill.name: language_name

weight_rationale: Primary anchor 2588 was independently found by down-projection language-name cosine (.291). Partner 11428 has weaker generic typically/normally/states outputs. Their pair causes .140 language_name drop vs .027 control; expanding with the next two attribution support neurons tests a small distributed lexical/contextual cluster.

label: English ordinal-word output support

skill.description: Produce the English ordinal word for a numbered position; control produces the cardinal word for the same position.
skill.name: ordinal_words

weight_rationale: Down-projection column has .497 cosine to ordinal mean after final norm. Top promoted tokens third, fourth, second, fifth, sixth and Chinese ordinal equivalents. Single-neuron ablation drops ordinal_words .304 with cardinal-word control .019 and all baseline skills <=.005.

label: matching closing-bracket transport

skill.description: Supply matching closing delimiter for an unfinished literal expression; matched control copies a supplied closing delimiter.
skill.name: bracket_closure

weight_rationale: All-layer OV scan ranks L43H55 highest for opening-to-matching-closing preference (.1335). Each of (, [, { maps most strongly to its corresponding closer among 43 probes (.057, .110, .080). Search ablation reduces bracket_closure .306 while matched copy control .005 and built-ins <=.006.

label: Punctuation-payload copying

skill.description: Copy a punctuation-only payload from a labeled field; matched control copies its alphabetic tag.
skill.name: symbol_copy

weight_rationale: Across all 40 layers L35H4 ranks third for punctuation OV identity contrast (.1218). Static full-vocabulary outputs preserve [ and {, ] and + with bracket variants as top tokens ([-variants 10.35-11.68, {10.65, ]8.52, +14.88). Activation independently enriched on symbol_copy 1.641. Single-head ablation drops symbol_copy .411 while matched word control improves .050; other active skills at most .017.

label: Color-word field retrieval

skill.description: Retrieve a color word from a named record among distractors; matched control retrieves digit string from same record.
skill.name: word_field_copy

weight_rationale: Static OV color identity contrast .1773 (third highest head among all layers); blue promotes English/Chinese blue variants top vocabulary6.95-7.31; white promotes white variants. Ablation reduced word-field copy .242 while numeric matched control improved .008 and other tasks drop at most .023.

label: signed-product polarity transport

skill.description: Determine positive/negative polarity of a product of signed integers, with matched operand magnitude control.
skill.name: product_polarity

weight_rationale: L38H26 ranks first among 960 linear heads for sign-token OV diagonal-minus-offdiagonal contrast (.06298), computed from value rows, head norm and output slice through effective final-norm unembedding. Single-head ablation reduced product_polarity .206 with magnitude control -.006 and all other targets <=.017.

label: Numerator/denominator answer support

skill.description: Identify numerator versus denominator from a referenced part of a fraction; controls copy the explicitly provided numeric part.
skill.name: fraction_role

weight_rationale: Unit 4840 promotes denominator/denomin/Den and numerator (raw logits 2.40 and 1.68); its gate is maximally aligned with denominator and numerator input embeddings. Its absolute fraction-token cosine .488 is over twice the runner-up in layer 22. Tests whether this lexical fraction-role direction supports identifying fraction components.

label: Sign transport in product descriptions

skill.description: Complete a sentence naming the sign of a two-integer product; controls name the sign of the first explicitly signed factor, using the same answer vocabulary.
skill.name: product_sign

weight_rationale: After weight-derived positive/negative task hypothesis, independent attribution highlighted L15H1. Weight inspection shows its dominant output singular direction contrasts products/multiplying/squares with divide/solving, and its static OV map preserves positive and negative as the strongest output tokens. This supports a sign-transport hypothesis in multiplication descriptions, tested against explicit-factor-sign controls.

label: negative-sign transport for product sign

skill.description: Complete a sentence naming the sign of a two-integer product; controls name the sign of the first explicitly signed factor, using the same answer vocabulary.
skill.name: product_sign

weight_rationale: Full-vocabulary static OV projection of negative gives Negative/negative variants as top outputs, 9.36-11.89, unlike positive. Independent attribution .167 and ablation product_sign .283 versus matched control .015 support a negative-sign transport hypothesis.

label: fraction role question interpretation

skill.description: Identify numerator versus denominator from a referenced part of a fraction; controls copy the explicitly provided numeric part.
skill.name: fraction_role

weight_rationale: L13 5848 gate/up concordantly align to question/request tokens (请问 .121 both; up What .095); 465 gate How .084. Attribution independently nominates these plus 5028/6566 for fraction role. Tests whether question parsing supports numerator/denominator selection.

label: fraction constituent selection

skill.description: Identify numerator versus denominator from a referenced part of a fraction; controls copy the explicitly provided numeric part.
skill.name: fraction_role

weight_rationale: L22h1 o_proj subspace aligns most with denominator (.030) among inspected role/syntax words. Static QK differentiates numerator queries (2/{) from denominator queries ()/+). Ablation selectively reduces fraction_role .160 with control -.003 and no other skill drop above .004; attribution independently ranks it .132.

label: Fraction-role blank-completion support

skill.description: Identify numerator versus denominator from a referenced part of a fraction; controls copy the explicitly provided numeric part.
skill.name: fraction_role

weight_rationale: Unit8061 reads and promotes underscore blanks (gate cosine .633 to space__, .631 to ____; down top tokens underscore variants). Unit7631 gates on sequence/context nouns and promotes sequence/system/dataset. Joint removal drops fraction_role .229 versus .001 matched control, with other target drops at most .031. This label describes benchmark contextual completion support, not a demonstrated fraction arithmetic algorithm.

label: signed mathematical role routing

skill.description: Complete a sentence naming the sign of a two-integer product; controls name the sign of the first explicitly signed factor, using the same answer vocabulary.
skill.name: product_sign

weight_rationale: L20h7 output projection aligns most with negative (.0377), denominator (.0332), numerator (.0329), positive (.0306) among inspected tokens. Static fraction-role queries prefer ^. Independent product-sign attribution .168; ablation product_sign .364 with control -.070 and largest other target drop fraction_role .110.

label: early relational expression support

skill.description: Identify numerator versus denominator from a referenced part of a fraction; controls copy the explicitly provided numeric part.
skill.name: fraction_role

weight_rationale: Weight anchor 1624 gates following/smallest/Next and outputs following .645, same .622; 2556 up product .125 and 3291 down instead .522. Their three-unit ablation drops fraction-role .127 with -.007 control. Expand within the same layer using independent attribution to test distributed relational support.

label: fraction expression interpretation

skill.description: Identify numerator versus denominator from a referenced part of a fraction; controls copy the explicitly provided numeric part.
skill.name: fraction_role

weight_rationale: L8 457 gate's strongest tokens are expression .145, Chinese 式 .134, expressions .122 and equation .106, supporting mathematical-expression input recognition. Independently attributed same-layer group tests fraction-role interpretation.

label: calendar-period support for month-offset completion

skill.description: Produce a calendar month after a small signed month offset, ignoring year; matched controls read a marker in the same context.
skill.name: month_offset

weight_rationale: Gate of L21 neuron 2434 ranks summer (.148), month (.146), seasons (.140), week (.138), winter (.136), semester (.133), months (.132), seasonal (.130). Down includes _hours, but is not a month-name copier. Attribution independently .171 and ablation .170 month-offset drop, matched control -.055 with other tasks near zero.

label: Fraction-role placeholder and argument-boundary completion

skill.description: Identify numerator versus denominator from a referenced part of a fraction; controls copy the explicitly provided numeric part.
skill.name: fraction_role

weight_rationale: L10 gates Label/roles (8789), placeholder (5575), Example (7796) identify role-label completion inputs; add 1783 whose up strongest token is '},{', separating braced arguments. Independent attribution ranks it .037 and base trio gave .159 search effect but failed held-out.

label: Product-sign parity and polarity features

skill.description: Complete a sentence naming the sign of a two-integer product; controls name the sign of the first explicitly signed factor, using the same answer vocabulary.
skill.name: product_sign

weight_rationale: 7756 gate negative/alternating/positive/parity, up parity/奇, down parity/direction/odd; gate/down weight neighbors 2789 (parity/sine/modulo gate), 6139 (sign/SIGN/direction up), 8783 (polarity/negative down). Single anchor drops product_sign .102; weight-neighbor cluster .170 with .003 control.

label: small-number operand support for month offsets

skill.description: Produce a calendar month after a small signed month offset, ignoring year; matched controls read a marker in the same context.
skill.name: month_offset

weight_rationale: L21 475 gate matches number words four .170, six .169, nine .150, five .149, three .141, eight .136, plus Chinese six/four. Down projection is not a month-name output copier. Attribution (.353) and ablation (.277) support month-offset dependence; control -.032, weekday .016, remaining skills near zero.
